subject: [PATCH v9 32/32] selftests/mm: add PMD swap entry tests

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch adds a set of tests to verify the behavior of PMD (Page Map Directory) swap entries in the Linux kernel. The tests cover various scenarios, including swapping out and back in THPs (Transparent Huge Pages), fork and cow operations, write and read access, and other edge cases. The tests use the MADV_PAGEOUT flag to swap out pages and verify that the thp_swpout_pmd counter is incremented correctly. Additionally, the patch adds a /proc/vmstat field reader to allow other tests to access this information. The tests are designed to be run on both synchronous and asynchronous devices, and skip certain operations if the kernel does not support them. With zswap enabled, some tests skip PMD-restoration assertions due to legitimate fallback behavior.
